# About project Panda Genetics is a simple Minecraft mod that allows player to check what genes a panda has by Shift+RMB on it. It is based on the Panda Info mod by mine_diver and PussyGarlic, but updated to Minecraft 26.1.x. ## Requirements - Minecraft 1.26.x - Fabric API ## License This project is under the MIT License, just like the project it's based on.
